[[File:Nyms_Stronghold_cloning_facility.jpg|thumb|250px|The cloning facility outside of Nym's Stronghold]]
A small '''cloning facility''' could be found outside of [[Nym's Stronghold]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

It was situated in a small, sand [[Color/Legends|colored]] building with an unknown number of floors below ground. It contained the technology necessary to [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] beings, as well as a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B droid]]. The building was surrounded by a crumbling stone wall. A [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporator]] stood next to the building.

==Behind the scenes==
The cloning facility is a place in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It provides players with a place to [[Wikipedia:Spawning (video gaming)|respawn]] ("clone") on Lok after they have been killed. The canonical status of such cloning facilities in ''Star Wars Galaxies''{{'}} is unknown.

The type of building used for this cloning facility is also used in many places on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the game. It usually features a turbolift to access two lower levels, but the buttons used to operate the elevator were removed in this building.
